data.name: Wiz Hunter
data.detailed_description:
Greetings, fellow adventurers! We're a small, passionate team who has poured our hearts into crafting a unique single-player deckbuilder that blends the strategic depth of card games with the unpredictability of roguelikes. Assemble a deck as unique as your journey, and confront strange creatures, uncover powerful artifacts, and hunt the last Wizards!

Features

  • Dynamic Deck Building: Choose your cards wisely! Discover loads of cards to add to your deck with each attempt at hunting wizards. Select cards that work together to efficiently dispatch foes and reach the end.

  • An Ever-changing World: Every journey in Wiz Hunter presents a new layout. Opt for a risky or safe route, encounter various foes, choose different cards, uncover unique artifacts, and even battle different bosses! But don't take too long! A relentless mist is gradually swallowing the land, and lingering too long on your path can result in being trapped in it, a fate that could spell the end even for the most seasoned adventurers.

  • Powerful Artifacts to Discover: Throughout Wiz Hunter, you can find mighty items known as artifacts. These artifacts can significantly boost your deck through powerful interactions, but be cautious, Artifacts often have a risky cost.

  • Upgrade! Upgrade! Upgrade!: During your adventure, you will find various upgrade stones that enhance your cards. These upgrades add an extra effect to the desired card, and utilizing these well can take your deck's synergy to a whole new level!

data.short_description: Wiz Hunter is a rogue-lite deckbuilding card game. Embark on a deadly quest to hunt down wizards through strategic, turn-based combat. Kill, die, learn, repeat.
